recipe.name: Node.js app
evidence: Scripts: build, build:watch, dev, lint, lint:fix, test, prepublishOnly

Start phase boots a real n8n in Docker with this package installed, executes two workflows against the live mNotify API, and serves readiness at /healthz/readiness on port 5688. It needs docker and MN_API_KEY in the environment; without the key it exits with a clear message.
n8n-node dev (npm run dev, port 5678) is the editing path only: it installs a second full n8n (about 2 GB), too heavy for a small host. Use it when changing the node source.
For build and test only, run: hermes verify --json --skip-start
